venue.name: [Sindicato Scotiabank Chile ex BBVA](https://www.sindicatoscotiabank.cl)
venue.address: Lord Cochrane 165, Santiago Centro, Región Metropolitana

items.information:
We are so happy to announce a new tournament in the capital of Chile, Santiago!
We hope this tournament will be very good and that you'll have a good time in it, with 5 different categories to participate.
To enter the venue you have to show your movility pass or have a negative test of Covid-19 no older than 24 hours.

Estamos muy felices de anunciar un nuevo torneo para la capital de Chile, Santiago!
Esperamos que este campeonato sea de lo mejor para que lo pasen bien, con 5 diferentes categorías para participar.
Para entrar al recinto deben mostrar su pase de movilidad o un test de Covid-19 negativo con un antigüedad menor a 24 horas.

items.name: Warm Up Stockholm 2022

venue.name: Torvalla Sportcentrum
venue.details: Torvalla Sporthall. Enter using the combined entrance to the swimming hall, then follow the signs.

items.information:
Welcome to Warm Up Stockholm 2022! This is a pre-competition to the Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022 in Copenhagen the weekend after. You are warmly welcome to compete, regardless of whether you solve the 3x3-cube in 4 seconds or 4 minutes. Please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

--

Varmt välkommen till Warm Up Stockholm 2022! Detta är en förtävling till Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022 i Köpenhamn helgen efter. Du är varmt välkommen att tävla, oavsett om du löser 3x3-kuben på 4 sekunder eller 4 minuter. Vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information kring tävlingen.
